rule: Names come from weighted templates over name pools (plain full name weight 171, nickname form weight 19, backer-style weight 10). keep: Short cards: most entries are one to three lines, which fit a 375-wide card.
Category-based placement: a lab door always reads as a lab; a motel always reads as a motel.
Weighted name templates: one pattern is common, a nickname form is rarer, a backer-style form is rarest.
Angle-bracket nesting: one template builds a sentence from several pools.
Small attitude vocabulary on factions (kill on sight, knows your voice, lets you in, watch your back, share my stuff, guard your stuff, defends your space).
change: No real-place name pool (the world pool of 20,900 entries looks like real place names).
No adult or distressing snippet text; write every sign, ad and note fresh.
No 25-faction matrix; 5-8 factions is enough for 700 zones.
Server decides placement and attitude; the client shows the card.
Our own names and our own voice; original category names.
look_test: On one phone at 375 wide, show three cards in a row: (a) a zone card with title, one placed sign and a two-line body; (b) a faction card with three attitude words and one line of story; (c) a named character card whose name comes from the template, with a nickname version beside it. Dom judges which reads fastest at a glance and whether the names feel like one population.
